title: Lesson 58 · A blessing in disguise?
titleZh: 第58课 是因祸得福吗？

examples.en: Rain after a long dry season is a blessing.
The tiny village is called Frinley.
The village is said to possess a cursed tree.
examples.zh: 据说这个村庄有一棵被诅咒的树。

examples.en: Nobody wants to touch the cursed tree.
examples.zh: 没有人愿意碰那棵被诅咒的树。

examples.en: The number of visitors has increased.
The tree has gained an evil reputation.
The tree has claimed a number of victims.
examples.zh: 这棵树已经害了不少人。

examples.en: The vicar refused to have the tree cut down.
The tree is a useful source of income.
examples.zh: 这棵树是一个有用的收入来源。

examples.en: The tourists bring income to the village.
The tree was planted fifty years ago.
examples.zh: 这棵树是五十年前种的。

examples.en: The tree has gained an evil reputation.
The tree has an evil reputation.
They cut their names on the tree-trunk.

sentences.en: The tiny village of Frinley is said to possess a cursed tree.
sentences.zh: 据说小村庄弗林利有一棵被诅咒的树。

sentences.en: The tree was planted near the church fifty years ago.
sentences.zh: 这棵树五十年前被种在教堂附近。

sentences.en: If he picks a leaf, he will die.
sentences.zh: 如果他摘下一片叶子，他就会死。

sentences.en: Many villagers believe that the tree has already claimed a number of victims.
sentences.zh: 许多村民相信这棵树已经害了不少人。

sentences.en: The vicar has been asked to have the tree cut down, but so far he has refused.
sentences.zh: 有人请求牧师把树砍掉，但到目前为止他拒绝了。

article.en: The tiny village of Frinley is said to possess a cursed tree.
article.zh: 据说小村庄弗林利有一棵被诅咒的树。

article.en: Because the tree was mentioned in a newspaper, the number of visitors to Frinley has now increased.
article.zh: 因为这棵树被一家报纸报道过，来弗林利的游客现在增多了。

article.en: The tree was planted near the church fifty years ago.
article.zh: 这棵树五十年前被种在教堂附近。

article.en: It is only in recent years that it has gained an evil reputation.
article.zh: 只是近几年它才得了恶名。

article.en: It is said that if anyone touches the tree, he will have bad luck.
article.zh: 据说谁要是碰了这棵树，就会倒霉。

article.en: If he picks a leaf, he will die.
article.zh: 如果他摘下一片叶子，他就会死。

article.en: Many villagers believe that the tree has already claimed a number of victims.
article.zh: 许多村民相信这棵树已经害了不少人。

article.en: The vicar has been asked to have the tree cut down, but so far he has refused.
article.zh: 有人请求牧师把树砍掉，但到目前为止他拒绝了。

article.en: He has pointed out that the tree is a useful source of income, as tourists have been coming from all parts of the country to see it.
article.zh: 他指出这棵树是一个有用的收入来源，因为游客们从全国各地赶来观看。

article.en: So far, not one of them has been struck down by sudden death!
article.zh: 到目前为止，还没有一个人突然死去！
